lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The service door lets out onto the allocation yard, and the allocation yard lets out onto the road, and the road goes two ways.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: East is the Basin and the cooling fields, and there is nothing out there but the thing I have just annoyed. West is the valley.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Monastery is north-west, up the valley, about four hours on foot. Walk. Running is what they are paid to notice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody is behind you yet. That is not the same as nobody coming.
